A robot program failed to move "red_pen" (kind: pen) onto "green_case".

candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
best_candidate = None
for c in candidates:
    if abs(c["yaw"] - (-1.335)) < 0.1 and abs(c["height"] - 0.0119) < 0.005:
        best_candidate = c
        break
if best_candidate is None:
    best_candidate = candidates[0]

grasp_result = grasp(best_candidate)
if not grasp_result["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp red_pen")

spots = free_spots("green_case", "red_pen")
if not spots["spots"]:
    raise RuntimeError("No free spot in green_case")

spot = spots["spots"][0]
target_yaw = spot["object_long_axis_yaw"]

# Adjust gripper yaw to match the desired object orientation at placement
# The object's long axis should be target_yaw, so the gripper yaw should be target_yaw + (gripper yaw at grasp - object long axis at grasp)
gripper_yaw_at_grasp = best_candidate["yaw"]
object_long_axis_at_grasp = best_candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]
gripper_yaw_for_placement = target_yaw + (gripper_yaw_at_grasp - object_long_axis_at_grasp)

carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=gripper_yaw_for_placement)
rotate_by(target_yaw - object_long_axis_at_grasp)  # Align object long axis to target
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("red_pen", "green_case")
